title: Stuck horse: ride through or keep trying
question: From PR #62 (issue #60): when the whistled horse gets stuck on rocks, it now rides through them for the rest of that call. Does that get you off the train more reliably, and does it look OK, compared with the old horse that keeps trying where it is?
conclusion: Riding through rocks on screen is no good (issue #82); off screen is fine. PR #62 now paths round on a tile grid, backs off when stuck and asks you to whistle from the other side.
